verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers a CLI for command-line/scripted use, server-side SDKs with automatic retries/token refresh suitable for automation, webhooks for event-driven pipelines, and scoped API keys for secure headless auth — all core building blocks for CI/automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or GitHub Actions integration, and independent hands-on confirmation of CLI use in automated/headless environments.
